{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["<note>by the common law of all people</note> (a false gloss on 'coycab')", "<note>from his mind</note>"], "mistranslated": ["one who is chaste (coycab) in words, deeds and thoughts -> 'Whoever is guided in words, deeds and thoughts'", "one who strives (ɔanuculintic) to drive them away (nachcunticoob) -> 'the one who consents to hold them'", "no, rather he gains merit (mayli cú nahaltic), if through them he removes the sinful occasions -> 'Yes, he commits it, if he does not remove the sinful things'", "one who strives to carry them out, or delights in them by his own will -> 'Whoever consents to do them, or who, once they are spoken, gives his will to them'", "what things help us to stay chaste -> 'What things do we have as people of this common world?'", "our devotions/penances (meyahtbaob) -> 'our works'", "immodesty/indecency, glances and conversations inclined to evil -> 'The shameless, the watchers and the sinners, the great evil ones'", "what is another's, against the will of its owner (ma tu ciboltic ti u yumil) -> 'what is not his own, and does not offend his lord'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["xmá tiblil 'indecency/immodesty' -> 'Bad conduct' (slightly loose)", "mix yanti 'nor keeps/has' -> rendered fine; meyahtbaob 'mortifications/penances' -> 'pious devotions' (slightly loose)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Translation B gets the catechism's meaning right on chastity and the seventh commandment, while A misreads coycab, reverses the answer about driving away evil thoughts, and garbles several other answers."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["masters should treat servants as children of God -> \"Just as God acts toward His children\" (the masters' duty is recast as God's conduct)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'or does not forgive the offender' (uaix ti ú ah pocħil má tu záat zicé), replaced by other content"], "added": ["\"or a physician who, through carelessness, does not save a life\"", "\"Do those who kill using tools or instruments bear guilt in this?\"", "\"grave punishment is given\""], "mistranslated": ["masters and servants (yuntzilóob / palilóob) -> \"the fathers and the children\"", "servants toward masters -> \"the children and their parents\"", "as with the children of God -> \"As the children of God are\"", "as those who serve God in them -> \"As each one who works for God, all of them\"", "what does it fully forbid, i.e. not killing -> \"what is the guilt that comes from killing\"", "mistreats/insults (zalcunahtic) -> \"binds another\"", "are there other ways that belong to killing? -> \"Do those who kill using tools or instruments bear guilt\"", "giving bad example (scandal) -> \"grave punishment is given\"", "or not giving help to one in extreme need -> \"and help is not given\" (the 'or' becomes 'and', and the clause reads as a statement of fact rather than a way of sinning)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the catechism's text closely (Ripalda's masters/servants and the fifth-commandment answers), while B misreads the roles and invents content about physicians, tools and punishment."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'cú lukzicpectzil' (takes away another's good name) in the answer on who sins against the eighth commandment", "'le hatzul cá unchacé' (as soon as he is able), which is replaced by an uncertainty note"], "added": ["\"He is to be reproved in this same way\""], "mistranslated": ["any notable harm / means of harm (nucul ti lob) -> \"makes any wicked instrument\"", "the one who stole (yoclah) -> \"whoever consents to it\"", "is it enough (ɔocanacti) to confess (tohpultic) his sin? -> \"will he be obliged to correct his sin?\"", "he must keep the intention (ɔanuculinte) to do it when he is able -> \"He is to be reproved in this same way, as far as is right\"", "unjustly (ti x má justicia) -> \"lacking justice\"", "desires (ɔibolahóob) -> \"The writings\" (only offered correctly in a note)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"vain words\"", "\"worldly\"", "\"rashly\""], "mistranslated": ["endless (x má xulilóob) listening to them -> \"listens to endless vain words\", which adds a slight gloss"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gives the catechism's sense accurately throughout with only small interpretive additions, while A misreads several key verbs (steal, enough to confess, intend) and renders 'desires' as 'writings'."}
